definition: to sail into a harbour on a trip
description: In a small harbour at sunset under dramatic clouds, a large three-masted sailing ship with grey sails comes into port past a stone lighthouse at the end of the pier, as waves splash high over the harbour wall. On the pier a man in a dark jacket swings a coiled rope towards the ship, and a crowd in yellow and orange oilskins cheers with raised arms. A bearded man in a dark jacket comes forward on the pier, smiling, and hauls in a coil of rope. Colourful houses and fishing boats line the harbour.

to crash over the harbour wall
